nodes.title: Your adjustments (e.g. make the shirt red)

widgets_values:
1. Draft is ~0.6MP so you get a preview faster. Pose + identity generate the whole frame (empty latent).
2. image1 = reference with the old person painted out (lighting/camera). image2 = DWPose on gray. Pose LoRA 0.9.
3. Marry starts from the GENERATE. Original kitchen is stamped back only where invert(old person OR new person). The old person never stays in the destination, so there is no ghost. No blur-heal. No second sampler.
4. Type extra directions in Your adjustments (e.g. make the shirt red).
5. Final is a lanczos upscale of the married draft.
CLIP type must be krea2.
